Disabling abbreviation expansion keeps tooltip titles out of page text

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "crawlberg"
engine_config = { 'content' => { 'expand_abbreviations' => false, 'extract_metadata' => false }, 'respect_robots_txt' => false }
engine = Crawlberg.create_engine(engine_config.to_json)
url = 'https://example.com'
result = Crawlberg.scrape(engine, url)
puts result.markdown.content.inspect
```
